name: figure-it-out
changes: 호출 제한을 OpenCode metadata.opencode/autoinvoke로 변환. 원본의 첫 todo와 단계 삽입 순서를 영속 todo 도구에 연결한다. 원본의 작업별 모델 선택을 필수 role 및 추론/속도 인자에 연결한다.
equivalence: Frame→Design→Run loop→Audit trail→Verify 5단계, 반증 가능한 완료 조건·규모와 엄격도·장시간 작업 체크포인트·검증 기반 선행·단위별 keep/revert·독립 심사·3종 판정·감사 기록·전체 제품 검증을 모두 보존. todo와 위임 호출 연결 2구간만 변경. show-me-your-work와 poteto-mode 전체 절차는 후속 순서에서 계속 포팅한다.
checks: exact reviewed replacements; all other bytes preserved

rewrites.before: Open a todolist whose first item is to read the Principles section of the **poteto-mode** skill. Then add the phases below as todos.
rewrites.after: Use `pstack_todo(action: "write", items: ...)` to open an ordered todo list whose first item is to read the Principles section of the **poteto-mode** skill. Then add the phases below as todos. Update the stored list as the designed units are added and completed; retain skipped steps with a reason.
rewrites.reason: 원본의 첫 todo와 단계 삽입 순서를 영속 todo 도구에 연결한다.

rewrites.before: - Decide what fans out. Parallelize only across seams, and give each worker its own worktree or branch (the **separate-before-serializing-shared-state** principle skill). Don't over-fan. Pick each subagent's reasoning level and fast or standard speed for the job, per the Subagents section of the **poteto-mode** skill.
rewrites.after: - Decide what fans out. Parallelize only across seams, and give each worker its own worktree or branch (the **separate-before-serializing-shared-state** principle skill). Don't over-fan. Pick each subagent's reasoning level and fast or standard speed for the job, per the Subagents section of the **poteto-mode** skill. Use native `subagent` with `background: true` and the appropriate required `role`: `feature, refactoring` for ordinary implementation, `hardest tasks` for the hardest work, `judgment and prose` for judgments, or the investigation role named by the routed skill. Set `difficulty` and `urgent` per that job. Resolve panels through `pstack_models` when the designed workflow calls for them; pass their role and seat to each invocation.
rewrites.reason: 원본의 작업별 모델 선택을 필수 role 및 추론/속도 인자에 연결한다.
